name: Tenstorrent Homebrew Tap
description: The official Homebrew tap (`brew tap tenstorrent/tools`) for Tenstorrent's fork of the Tracy profiler GUI, used to view tt-metal device and host profiling captures. It ships two formulae that both install a `tracy` binary: `tracy`, pinned to a tagged release with a checksum, and `tracy-experimental`, which builds from any branch set in `HOMEBREW_TRACY_BRANCH`. Supports macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon) and Linux via Linuxbrew.
